'Bath house' with showers per a Google review of 2026 ('Could use a stool in the shower stall').

note: Private family campground near Milton, DE, owned and run by its founder, a pastor, beside the church he founded; open and wooded sites, cabins and tent sites. Minutes from the bay and ocean beaches. Deep Branch (a shallow stream from Flaxhole Pond) runs along the property line, but no confirmation sites sit on the water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $50 flat for 2026 and the weekend/holiday minimums; added season May 1-Nov 1, 50 amp, booking by inquiry form, facilities; cleared the ~30 ft length no page states. Passes the gate at exactly $50, not over.
flags: GATE FACTS: posted 2026 rate exactly $50.00 per night per unit on the operator's rates page (no resort or per-person fee stated; no over-$50 figure), so at the line, not over it. Good Sam: not stated by the operator. Gateway: none within 40 km (nearest Ocean City MD 55 km). 2027 rates not posted yet. A rise of any size for 2027 would put it over.

REVIEWS: Google 4.4 from 176 reviews. Google's panel also showed '5.0 stars 190 Reviews' beside it, source not identified. RV Life 3.5 from 9 ratings (site lists 100 sites, avg $40), under 25 so no rule applies. Stored rating says RV Life 4. Campendium and The Dyrt not read. Quotes: 'Bathrooms are clean and updated... Power seems to fluctuate as power watch dog keep triggering when. Voltage drops below 104.' (4 months ago); 'Well, the pics on their site must be from way back looks nothing like that when you get there' (a year ago, on a cabin); 'Some reviews talked about some smell. We smelled something slightly one night but it wasn't overpowering' (a year ago). Imagery shows four long barns ~270 m west of the pin; I can't say what they are.
FACILITY ISSUE: home-page banner 'OUR POOL IS CURRENTLY CLOSED - WE ARE WORKING TOWARDS OPENING THE NEW POOL', no date. Power fluctuation per the review above.

SEASONAL: operator posts a $3,300 season and $1000 monthly beside the nightly rate, and the map shows about 100 numbered sites, but no page gives the seasonal share and the Google reviews I read don't mention residents. I do not read it as mostly seasonal; imagery shows some clustered units along the eastern rows, not enough to count. I read it as a borderline price and not a borderline park.
RESERVATIONS are by inquiry form and phone, no online engine, though the home page button says BOOK A SITE.
WATERFRONT stays not waterfront: the operator puts Deep Branch only 'along the property line'; the campsite map shows no water and imagery shows it under canopy, no site on it.

PIN: stored 38.8062,-75.2853 is in unbroken trees ~100-150 m south-west of the rows visible on imagery (roughly 38.8075,-75.2848); under the 250 m line. RV Life's own pin 38.80302,-75.28284 looks like the entrance end.
